profile.summary: A nonprofit youth mentoring organization in Oakland, California. It supports young people through mentoring, leadership development, community and family engagement, education supports and artistic expression, and runs a youth and family center in West Oakland for after-school and summer programs.

sources.title: UrbanLife Youth & Family Center - Thrive Collective

review.notes: ProPublica confirms a 501(c)(3) 'Urbanlife Mentors' in Oakland, CA (EIN 83-1200004, youth development), and the Thrive Collective page confirms the Oakland youth mentoring programs described in the summary; this fits OUSD's elementary-school mentoring and support contracts. The summary is neutral and supported (it omits the faith-formation element, which is not a false claim); no source names OUSD directly, and ProPublica notes the org is not on the current IRS exempt list, but the identity match is strong.
